The CLI security game on PQXDH directories with SPQR

Trusted: the statement. Read with PqDir.lean (CliSpecPqxdh, encodeDir, pqInputs) and Run.lean (in LibsignalBinary/Specifications/SignalSession/), and Computational/Specifications/Game/StatementBinaryHarnessCore.lean. See Computational/docs/TRUSTED_BASE.md.

Multi-session security game cliPqExp and distinguishing advantage CliPqxdhAdvantage for a libsignal command-line client run : CliRun executing PQXDH handshakes followed by SPQR-augmented Double Ratchet sessions. It instantiates the generic composed game G(Σ) (Computational/Specifications/Game/GenericGame.lean) at the CLI interface cliIface (Σ_bin), where each ACD19 secure-messaging (SM) step (init, send, recv) is one invocation of run on a party directory; the headline theorems instantiate run with the placed ARM64 semantics Placed.cliRunPlacedSig (LibsignalBinary/Specifications/SignalSession/CliBinaryPq.lean).

At startDR, Alice's init <Bob> bundle runs on her initial encodeDir directory (pqInitInputs) and Bob's initial directory is encoded once from the KeyInd metadata (cliPartyStateB0). Across exit 0 invocations, Dir.cliPqAfter reads back all present party files along cliPqPartyPathsOf (cliPqReadBack) as the retained directory CliPartyState.dir passed to the next send or recv (cliPqDirInputs), recording sessions/<peer> in CliPartyState.bin.bytes; on corr-P, cliOracleImplR projects leaked state to CliPartyState.bin : BinState.

DEV-CLI13 (formalization): Alice refuses every input whose first byte is 3. CliSpecPqxdh covers a pre-key message only when the session matches it or there is none, whereas Alice always holds the session she started; Dir.cliPqReceive refuses every byte-3-prefixed input to Alice before calling run. Effect: no claim about Alice receiving a pre-key message; honest Bob never sends one.

DEV-CLI14 (formalization): explicit length gate; restricts the adversary. Dir.cliPqReceive refuses inputs of 2^32 bytes or more and canonical pre-key messages whose inner message has 2^32 - 2048 bytes or more (cliPqLenOk) before calling run, matching the injection filter bhInjOK. For plaintext length bound l < 10^6, no honest ciphertext reaches this threshold.

DEV-CLI18 (formalization): exit 0 directory retention, non-zero exit rollback, and BinState leakage projection. Across exit 0 calls, CliPartyState.dir retains the full party directory snapshot (cliPqReadBack over cliPqPartyPathsOf), while corr-P leaks only CliPartyState.bin : BinState (matching modelIface's GhostState Bytes corruption surface rather than long-term identity or pre-key secret files). On any non-zero exit (exited c with c ≠ 0, aborted, or none), Dir.cliPqAfter returns none and leaves CliPartyState unchanged: under CliSpecPqxdh rejected calls leave party files untouched, allocation-failure aborts (DEV-CLI15) are accounted for separately in the CLI security bound, and mid-commit OS/I/O failures during sequential multi-file writes (EMFILE, ENOSPC, EIO, power loss) are out of scope (DEV-CLI4). Effect: out of scope (partial-write crash recovery on non-zero exit).

def cliPqPartyPaths (party : Party) (spkIds opkIds otkIds lrkIds : List (BitVec 32)) : List String := [addressFile, identityKeyPairFile, registrationIdFile, identityFile (partyAddressName party.other), sessionFile (partyAddress party.other)] ++ spkIds.map signedPreKeyFile ++ opkIds.map oneTimePreKeyFile ++ otkIds.map oneTimeKyberPreKeyFile ++ (lrkIds.map fun i => [lastResortKyberPreKeyFile i, baseKeysFile i]).flatten

def cliPqPartyPathsOfL88–93 ↗#

def cliPqPartyPathsOf (st : PqParty) : List String := cliPqPartyPaths st.party (st.signed.map (·.1)) (st.oneTime.map (·.1)) (st.kyberOneTime.map (·.1)) (st.kyberLastResort.map (·.1))

def cliPqReadBackL95–99 ↗#

Read back present party files along paths from fs, omitting missing paths (fs p = none) while keeping empty files (fs p = some []).

def cliPqReadBack (paths : List String) (fs : String → Option (List (BitVec 8))) : List (String × List (BitVec 8)) := paths.filterMap fun p => (fs p).map fun bs => (p, bs)

def cliPqDirInputsL101–108 ↗#

Build CLI Inputs for cmd from a retained party directory dir, extra files, coin bytes, and stdin.

def cliPqDirInputs (dir : List (String × List (BitVec 8))) (cmd : Cmd) (extra : List (String × List (BitVec 8))) (coins stdin : List (BitVec 8)) : Inputs := { argv := cmd.argv dirs := partyDirs ++ (match cmd with | .init _ dir => [dir] | _ => []) files := dir ++ extra ++ [(coinsFile, coins)] stdin := stdin }

def cliPqSig64L110–112 ↗#

Coerce bs to a 64-byte signature vector, defaulting to zeros when bs.length ≠ 64.

def cliPqSig64 (bs : SignalPqxdh.Bytes) : List.Vector (BitVec 8) 64 := (fitU8VecStrict 64 bs).getD (List.Vector.replicate 64 0#8)

def cliPqxdhDirBobBeforeAcceptL114–126 ↗#

Bob's initial PqParty directory before his first accept in instance bi, pinning Alice's identity key and installing the responder slot's signed pre-key, last-resort Kyber pre-key (with no seen base keys), and optional one-time pre-key, with no session.

def cliPqxdhDirBobBeforeAccept {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} {l : Nat} (bi : ModelDriverInstance S l) (sigs : List.Vector (BitVec 8) 64 × List.Vector (BitVec 8) 64) : PqParty := let spk : PqSignedKey := { priv := bi.keysB.spkPriv, sig := sigs.1, timestamp := 0#64 } let kpk : PqKyberKey := { pub := bi.keysB.kpkPub, sec := bi.keysB.kpkSec, sig := sigs.2, timestamp := 0#64 } { party := .B, me := bi.meB, peerId := some (bhIdKeyOf bi.hdr.ikAPk), session := none, signed := [(bi.keysB.spkId, spk)] oneTime := match bi.keysB.opk with | some (i, sk) => [(i, some sk)] | none => [] kyberOneTime := [] kyberLastResort := [(bi.keysB.kpkId, kpk, [])] }

def cliPqLenOkL145–151 ↗#

Ciphertext length gate (DEV-CLI14): requires shortCiphertext c (< 2 ^ 32 bytes) and inner payload length < 2 ^ 32 - 2048 on canonical tag-3 wires.

def cliPqLenOk (c : List (BitVec 8)) : Bool := shortCiphertext c && match bhDecodePreKeyMsgE c with | some m => decide (m.inner.length + 2048 < 2 ^ 32) | none => true

def cliPqSigsOfL153–158 ↗#

Responder slot's (spkSig, pqspkSig) read from st.spkBundles (zero-filled if absent).

def cliPqSigsOf {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} {l : Nat} (st : SignalPqxdh.KeyIndState S) (bi : ModelDriverInstance S l) : List.Vector (BitVec 8) 64 × List.Vector (BitVec 8) 64 := match st.spkBundles.find? (fun (idx, _) => idx == (bi.respSlot.1.val, bi.respSlot.2.val)) with | some (_, e) => (cliPqSig64 e.spkSig, cliPqSig64 e.pqspkSig) | none => (cliPqSig64 [], cliPqSig64 [])

def cliMapGameStateL160–174 ↗#

Map f : St' → St over the per-party states of an SM.GameState, keeping all metadata unchanged.

def cliMapGameState {St' St Msg C : Type} (f : St' → St) (gs : SM.GameState St' Msg C) : SM.GameState St Msg C := { st := fun P => f (gs.st P) epoch := gs.epoch idx := gs.idx tL := gs.tL trans := gs.trans chall := gs.chall comp := gs.comp maxAcc := gs.maxAcc b := gs.b win := gs.win leaks := gs.leaks }

def cliConfigSpkSL176–187 ↗#

Lift bhConfigSpkS (SM.ConfigR BinState Msg Bytes) to an arbitrary party-state type St.

def cliConfigSpkS {Pt : Type} (decT : PublicKey → Option Pt) (encT : Pt → PublicKey) {St Msg : Type} : SM.ConfigR St Msg Bytes := let c := bhConfigSpkS (Msg := Msg) decT encT let toBin : SM.GameState St Msg Bytes → SM.GameState BinState Msg Bytes := cliMapGameState (fun _ => ⟨.A, [], ⟨0, []⟩⟩) { base := c.base r1 := c.r1 must := fun gs => c.must (toBin gs) sendOK := fun gs => c.sendOK (toBin gs) corrOK := fun gs => c.corrOK (toBin gs) injOK := c.injOK }

def cliOracleImplRL189–199 ↗#

R-game SM oracles running over internal party state St' and projecting corr-P leakage along proj : St' → St (DEV-CLI18).

def cliOracleImplR {Key St' St Msg Coins RCoins C : Type} [DecidableEq Msg] [DecidableEq C] [SampleableType Coins] [SampleableType RCoins] (proj : St' → St) (sm : SMSchemeR Key St' Msg Coins RCoins C) (Δ qep : Nat) (cfg : SM.ConfigR St' Msg C) : QueryImpl (SM.spec St Msg Coins C) (StateT (SM.GameState St' Msg C) ProbComp) := SM.transmitR sm Δ qep cfg + SM.challR sm Δ qep cfg + SM.deliverR sm cfg + SM.injectR sm Δ qep cfg + (fun P => Option.map proj <$> SM.corrR cfg P : QueryImpl (Party →ₒ Option St) (StateT (SM.GameState St' Msg C) ProbComp))

def cliPqAfterL241–247 ↗#

Extract (cliPqReadBack paths fs, sessions/<peer>, stdout) on exited 0, or none on any other outcome (DEV-CLI18).

def cliPqAfter (P : Party) (paths : List String) : Option Outcome → Option (List (String × List (BitVec 8)) × List (BitVec 8) × List (BitVec 8)) | some (.exited 0 out fs) => some (cliPqReadBack paths fs, (fs (sessionFile (partyAddress P.other))).getD [], out) | _ => none

def cliPqInitL249–257 ↗#

Run Alice's init <Bob> bundle call with 192-byte tape t, returning her initial CliPartyState on exited 0.

def cliPqInit (run : CliRun) (W : PEParams) (dA : PqParty) (b : PreKeyBundleFields) (t : List.Vector (BitVec 8) initiateTapeLen) : Option CliPartyState := let pathsA := cliPqPartyPathsOf dA (cliPqAfter .A pathsA (run (pqInitInputs W dA b t))).map fun (dirA, recA, _) => { bin := { party := .A, bytes := recA, epochs := { epoch := 0, chains := [(⟨b.spkPub⟩, 0)] } } paths := pathsA dir := dirA }

def cliPqSendL259–268 ↗#

Run send <peer> on s.dir with 64-byte send coins rs, updating s and returning stdout on exited 0, or (s, []) otherwise.

def cliPqSend (run : CliRun) (s : CliPartyState) (m : List (BitVec 8)) (rs : BitVec 512) : CliPartyState × List (BitVec 8) := match cliPqAfter s.bin.party s.paths (run (cliPqSendInp s m rs)) with | some (dir', recB, wire) => ({ bin := { party := s.bin.party, bytes := recB, epochs := s.bin.epochs.send s.bin.party } paths := s.paths dir := dir' }, wire) | none => (s, [])

def cliPqRecvL270–284 ↗#

Run recv <peer> on s.dir with 32-byte receive coins rc, updating s and parsing the inner SignalMessage header for (epoch, index) on exited 0.

def cliPqRecv (run : CliRun) (s : CliPartyState) (c : List (BitVec 8)) (rc : BitVec 256) : Option (CliPartyState × Nat × Nat × List (BitVec 8)) := (cliPqAfter s.bin.party s.paths (run (cliPqRecvInp s c rc))).map fun (dir', recB, pt) => match (bhWireInnerBytes c).map (SignalMessage.tryFrom protoSignalCodec) with | some (.ok msg) => let (t, ep') := s.bin.epochs.recv msg.senderRatchetKey ({ bin := { party := s.bin.party, bytes := recB, epochs := ep' } paths := s.paths, dir := dir' }, t, msg.counter.toNat + 1, pt) | _ => ({ bin := { party := s.bin.party, bytes := recB, epochs := s.bin.epochs } paths := s.paths, dir := dir' }, s.bin.epochs.epoch, 0, pt)

def cliPqReceiveL286–311 ↗#

Receive step of instance bi (DEV-CLI13, DEV-CLI14): enforces cliPqLenOk, refuses any wirePrekey-prefixed input to Alice, and checks partnered pre-key or whisper framing for Bob before invoking cliPqRecv.

def cliPqReceive (run : CliRun) (l : Nat) {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} {l' : Nat} (bi : ModelDriverInstance S l') (s : CliPartyState) (c : List (BitVec 8)) (rc : BitVec 256) : Option (CliPartyState × Nat × Nat × Plain l) := let call := fun _ : Unit => (cliPqRecv run s c rc).map fun x => (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, padOrTruncatePlain l x.2.2.2) if !cliPqLenOk c then none else match s.bin.party with | .A => if c.head? == some wirePrekey then none else call () | .B => match bhDecodePreKeyMsgE c with | some m => if s.bin.bytes.isEmpty || s.bin.epochs.epoch == 0 then if c == wirePrekey :: (bhExpectedPreKeyMsg bi.meA.regId bi.hdr m.inner).bytes then call () else none else if bhHdrOfPreKeyMsg m == bi.hdr then call () else none | none => if s.bin.bytes.isEmpty || s.bin.epochs.epoch == 0 then none else if c.head? == some wireWhisper then call () else none

def cliPqSchemeL313–320 ↗#

SMSchemeR of promoted instance bi over retained CliPartyState directories.

def cliPqScheme (run : CliRun) (l : Nat) {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} {l' : Nat} (bi : ModelDriverInstance S l') (stA0 stB0 : CliPartyState) : SMSchemeR Unit CliPartyState (Plain l) (BitVec 512) (BitVec 256) Bytes where initA _ := stA0 initB _ := stB0 send s m rs := cliPqSend run s m.toList rs receive s c rc := cliPqReceive run l bi s c rc

def cliPqReceiveML337–359 ↗#

def cliPqReceiveM {M : Type → Type} [Monad M] (runM : Inputs → M (Option Outcome)) (l : Nat) {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} {l' : Nat} (bi : ModelDriverInstance S l') (s : CliPartyState) (c : List (BitVec 8)) (rc : BitVec 256) : M (Option (CliPartyState × Nat × Nat × Plain l)) := let call := fun _ : Unit => (fun r => r.map fun x => (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, padOrTruncatePlain l x.2.2.2)) <$> cliPqRecvM runM s c rc if !cliPqLenOk c then pure none else match s.bin.party with | .A => if c.head? == some wirePrekey then pure none else call () | .B => match bhDecodePreKeyMsgE c with | some m => if s.bin.bytes.isEmpty || s.bin.epochs.epoch == 0 then if c == wirePrekey :: (bhExpectedPreKeyMsg bi.meA.regId bi.hdr m.inner).bytes then call () else pure none else if bhHdrOfPreKeyMsg m == bi.hdr then call () else pure none | none => if s.bin.bytes.isEmpty || s.bin.epochs.epoch == 0 then pure none else if c.head? == some wireWhisper then call () else pure none

def cliPqSchemeML361–369 ↗#

Monadic SMSchemeRM of promoted instance bi for an effectful runner runM.

def cliPqSchemeM {M : Type → Type} [Monad M] (runM : Inputs → M (Option Outcome)) (l : Nat) {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} {l' : Nat} (bi : ModelDriverInstance S l') (stA0 stB0 : CliPartyState) : SMSchemeRM M Unit CliPartyState (Plain l) (BitVec 512) (BitVec 256) Bytes where initA _ := stA0 initB _ := stB0 send s m rs := cliPqSendM runM s m.toList rs receive s c rc := cliPqReceiveM runM l bi s c rc

CLI game driver and security experiment

def cliDrvStartML373–431 ↗#

Promote initiator session sid to a Double Ratchet instance: checks bhDrvGuard, evaluates testSession and revealSpkSk, runs Alice's init call via cliPqInitM, and commits the updated KeyIndState and new instance only if cliPqInitM succeeds.

def cliDrvStartM {M : Type → Type} [Monad M] [MonadLiftT ProbComp M] (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) (l : Nat) (P : SignalPqxdh.Primitives) (runM : Inputs → M (Option Outcome)) (W : PEParams) (mode : BHDrvMode S) (sid : SignalPqxdh.SessionId S) : CliDrvMT S l M (Option Nat) := do let ds ← get let some (hdr, bnd, (u_resp, j_resp)) := bhDrvGuard ds.toModelDriverState sid | return none let st0 ← StateT.lift get let (.drKeyResp _, st1) ← StateT.lift (liftM ((SignalPqxdh.pqxdhKeyIndImpl false S P (.testSession sid)).run st0)) | return none let (.spkSkResp spkSk, st) ← StateT.lift (liftM ((SignalPqxdh.pqxdhKeyIndImpl false S P (.revealSpkSk u_resp j_resp)).run st1)) | return none let t_dr ← StateT.lift (liftM ($ᵗ List.Vector (BitVec 8) 32)) let some (_, u_init, _, t_init) := ds.initTapes.find? (fun (s, _, _, _) => s == sid) | return none let some (_, initPrinEntry) := st.principals.find? (fun (idx, _) => idx == u_init.val) | return none let some (_, respPrinEntry) := st.principals.find? (fun (idx, _) => idx == u_resp.val) | return none let some (_, respSpkEntry) := st.spkBundles.find? (fun (idx, _) => idx == (u_resp.val, j_resp.val)) | return none let opkSk? ← match hdr.opkId? with | none => pure (some none) | some opkId => match st.opkEntries.find? def cliRunStdSMML438–467 ↗#

Execute an admissible SM query q on promoted instance i via cliOracleImplRM, aligning gs.trans on post-accept Bob deliveries and projecting corr-P leakage to BinState.

def cliRunStdSMM {M : Type → Type} [Monad M] [MonadLiftT ProbComp M] (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) (l : Nat) {Pt : Type} (runM : Inputs → M (Option Outcome)) (qep : Nat) (decT : PublicKey → Option Pt) (encT : Pt → PublicKey) (ds : CliDriverState S l) (i : Nat) (bi : ModelDriverInstance S l) (im : ModelDriverInstanceMeta S) (gs : SM.GameState CliPartyState (Plain l) Bytes) (q : (cliGameSmSpec l (BitVec 512)).Domain) : CliDrvMT S l M ((cliGameSmSpec l (BitVec 512)).Range q) := do let scheme := cliPqSchemeM runM l bi (gs.st .A) (gs.st .B) let cfg := cliConfigSpkS (St := CliPartyState) (Msg := Plain l) decT encT let gsIn : SM.GameState CliPartyState (Plain l) Bytes := match q with | .inl (.inl (.inr (.B, c))) => bhAlignTransForBob im.bobAccepted bi.meA.regId bi.hdr c gs | _ => gs let (r, gsOut) ← StateT.lift (StateT.lift ((cliOracleImplRM CliPartyState.bin scheme (2 + 1) qep cfg q).run gsIn)) let gs' : SM.GameState CliPartyState (Plain l) Bytes := match q, r with | .inl (.inl (.inr (.B, c))), some (.accepted _ _ _) => match gsIn.inTransit .A c with | some rMatched => { gsOut with trans := gs.trans.filter (fun rec => rec.pos != rMatched.pos) } | none => { gsOut with trans := gs.trans } | .inl (.inl (.inr (.B, _))), _ => { gsOut with trans := gs.trans } | _, _ => gsOut let im' := bhMetaAfterSM ds.toModelDriverState bi im q r set { ds with bhInsts := ds.bhInsts.set i { bi with gs := some (cliMapGameState CliPartyState.bin gs') }, instMeta := ds.instMeta.set i im', instGs := ds.instGs.set i (some gs') } return r

def cliRunStdSML469–476 ↗#

def cliRunStdSM (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) (l : Nat) {Pt : Type} (run : CliRun) (qep : Nat) (decT : PublicKey → Option Pt) (encT : Pt → PublicKey) (ds : CliDriverState S l) (i : Nat) (bi : ModelDriverInstance S l) (im : ModelDriverInstanceMeta S) (gs : SM.GameState CliPartyState (Plain l) Bytes) (q : (cliGameSmSpec l (BitVec 512)).Domain) : CliDrvM S l ((cliGameSmSpec l (BitVec 512)).Range q) := cliRunStdSMM S l (cliRunPure run) qep decT encT ds i bi im gs q

def cliStepLocalSMML478–502 ↗#

Pre-filter canonical pre-key wires to Alice and unpartnered or duplicate-in-transit wires to Bob before calling cliRunStdSMM.

def cliStepLocalSMM {M : Type → Type} [Monad M] [MonadLiftT ProbComp M] (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) (l : Nat) {Pt : Type} (runM : Inputs → M (Option Outcome)) (qep : Nat) (decT : PublicKey → Option Pt) (encT : Pt → PublicKey) (ds : CliDriverState S l) (i : Nat) (bi : ModelDriverInstance S l) (im : ModelDriverInstanceMeta S) (gs : SM.GameState CliPartyState (Plain l) Bytes) : (q : (cliGameSmSpec l (BitVec 512)).Domain) → CliDrvMT S l M ((cliGameSmSpec l (BitVec 512)).Range q) | .inl (.inl (.inr (.A, c))) => do if (bhDecodePreKeyMsgE c).isSome then return none else cliRunStdSMM S l runM qep decT encT ds i bi im gs (.inl (.inl (.inr (.A, c)))) | .inl (.inr (.A, c)) => do if (bhDecodePreKeyMsgE c).isSome then return none else cliRunStdSMM S l runM qep decT encT ds i bi im gs (.inl (.inr (.A, c))) | .inl (.inl (.inr (.B, c))) => do if (bhPartneredInnerBytes im.bobAccepted bi.meA.regId bi.hdr c).isNone then return none else cliRunStdSMM S l runM qep decT encT ds i bi im gs (.inl (.inl (.inr (.B, c)))) | .inl (.inr (.B, c)) => do if !im.bobAccepted then return none else if (bhPartneredInnerBytes true bi.meA.regId bi.hdr c).isNone || bhPartneredInTransitA true bi.meA.regId bi.hdr c gs then return none else cliRunStdSMM S l runM qep decT encT ds i bi im gs (.inl (.inr (.B, c))) | q => cliRunStdSMM S l runM qep decT encT ds i bi im gs q

def cliStepLocalSML504–511 ↗#

def cliStepLocalSM (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) (l : Nat) {Pt : Type} (run : CliRun) (qep : Nat) (decT : PublicKey → Option Pt) (encT : Pt → PublicKey) (ds : CliDriverState S l) (i : Nat) (bi : ModelDriverInstance S l) (im : ModelDriverInstanceMeta S) (gs : SM.GameState CliPartyState (Plain l) Bytes) : (q : (cliGameSmSpec l (BitVec 512)).Domain) → CliDrvM S l ((cliGameSmSpec l (BitVec 512)).Range q) := cliStepLocalSMM S l (cliRunPure run) qep decT encT ds i bi im gs

abbrev cliDrvSMML513–535 ↗#

Per-instance SM oracle handler checking bhDrvInstClean and pre-accept ikA corruption before dispatching to cliStepLocalSMM (or ext for external instances).

abbrev cliDrvSMM {M : Type → Type} [Monad M] [MonadLiftT ProbComp M] (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) (l : Nat) {Pt : Type} (runM : Inputs → M (Option Outcome)) (qep : Nat) (decT : PublicKey → Option Pt) (encT : Pt → PublicKey) (ext : QueryImpl (cliGameSmSpec l (BitVec 512)) (CliDrvMT S l M)) : QueryImpl (cliGameDrSpec l (BitVec 512)) (CliDrvMT S l M) := fun ⟨i, q⟩ => do let ds ← get if !bhDrvInstClean ds.toModelDriverState i then return bhSmDefaultWithSpqr q else match ds.bhInsts[i]?, ds.instMeta[i]? with | some bi, some im => if !im.bobAccepted && bhIsBobRecvSMQuery q && bhInstIkACorrupted ds.toModelDriverState bi then let imCorr : ModelDriverInstanceMeta S := { im with bobAccepted := true, ikACorrAtAccept := true } set { ds with instMeta := ds.instMeta.set i imCorr }; return bhSmDefaultWithSpqr q else match ds.instGs[i]? with | some (some gs) => cliStepLocalSMM S l runM qep decT encT ds i bi im gs q | _ => let r ← ext q set { ds with instMeta := ds.instMeta.set i (bhMetaAfterSM ds.toModelDriverState bi im q r) }; return r | _, _ => return bhSmDefaultWithSpqr q

def cliDrvSML537–542 ↗#

def cliDrvSM (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) (l : Nat) {Pt : Type} (run : CliRun) (qep : Nat) (decT : PublicKey → Option Pt) (encT : Pt → PublicKey) (ext : QueryImpl (cliGameSmSpec l (BitVec 512)) (CliDrvM S l)) : QueryImpl (cliGameDrSpec l (BitVec 512)) (CliDrvM S l) := cliDrvSMM S l (cliRunPure run) qep decT encT ext

def cliDrvCtl (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) (l : Nat) (P : SignalPqxdh.Primitives) (run : CliRun) (W : PEParams) (mode : BHDrvMode S) : QueryImpl (bhDrCtlSpec S) (CliDrvM S l) | .startDR sid => cliDrvStart S l P run W mode sid

abbrev cliDrvImplML555–565 ↗#

Full composed-game oracle handler combining uniform coins, one-key real-HKDF bhDrvKeyInd, cliDrvCtlM, and cliDrvSMM.

abbrev cliDrvImplM {M : Type → Type} [Monad M] [MonadLiftT ProbComp M] (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) (l : Nat) {Pt : Type} (P : SignalPqxdh.Primitives) (runM : Inputs → M (Option Outcome)) (W : PEParams) (qep : Nat) (decT : PublicKey → Option Pt) (encT : Pt → PublicKey) (ext : QueryImpl (cliGameSmSpec l (BitVec 512)) (CliDrvMT S l M)) (mode : BHDrvMode S) : QueryImpl (cliGameSpec S l (BitVec 512)) (CliDrvMT S l M) := (QueryImpl.ofLift unifSpec ProbComp).liftTarget (CliDrvMT S l M) + (fun q => bhLiftCliM (M := M) (bhDrvKeyInd S l P false q)) + cliDrvCtlM S l P runM W mode + cliDrvSMM S l runM qep decT encT ext

def cliDrvImplL567–574 ↗#

def cliDrvImpl (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) (l : Nat) {Pt : Type} (P : SignalPqxdh.Primitives) (run : CliRun) (W : PEParams) (qep : Nat) (decT : PublicKey → Option Pt) (encT : Pt → PublicKey) (ext : QueryImpl (cliGameSmSpec l (BitVec 512)) (CliDrvM S l)) (mode : BHDrvMode S) : QueryImpl (cliGameSpec S l (BitVec 512)) (CliDrvM S l) := (QueryImpl.ofLift unifSpec ProbComp).liftTarget (CliDrvM S l) + (fun q => bhLiftCli (bhDrvKeyInd S l P false q)) + cliDrvCtl S l P run W mode + cliDrvSM S l run qep decT encT ext
end Dir

def cliIfaceL578–590 ↗#

CLI protocol interface Σ_bin of G(Σ) for runner run, model primitives modelPrims X W, plaintext byte length l, and epoch cap qep, with BinState corruption leakage and win predicate driverSomeInstanceWon.

def cliIface (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) (run : CliRun) (X : UnreachedPqxdhPrimitives) (W : PEParams) (l qep : Nat) {Pt : Type} (decT : PublicKey → Option Pt) (encT : Pt → PublicKey) : ComposedIface S l where St := BinState prims := modelPrims X W Drv := CliDriverState S l init _ := {} impl b := Dir.cliDrvImpl S l (modelPrims X W) run W qep decT encT bhNoExtWithSpqr (fun _ _ _ _ _ => some b) won ds b := driverSomeInstanceWon ds.toModelDriverState b

def cliPqExpL592–598 ↗#

Multi-session CLI security experiment G(Σ_bin) on PQXDH + SPQR party directories: runs A against cliIface, returning a uniform bit if allTestedSessionsFresh (modelPrims X W) fails at game end and (b' == b || driverSomeInstanceWon ds.toModelDriverState b) otherwise.

def cliPqExp (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) (run : CliRun) (X : UnreachedPqxdhPrimitives) (W : PEParams) (l qep : Nat) {Pt : Type} (decT : PublicKey → Option Pt) (encT : Pt → PublicKey) (A : CliGameAdversary S l (BitVec 512)) : ProbComp Bool := composedExp (cliIface S run X W l qep decT encT) A.run

def CliPqxdhAdvantageL600–607 ↗#

Distinguishing advantage 2 |Pr[cliPqExp … = true] - 1/2| (boolBias) of A in cliPqExp.

noncomputable def CliPqxdhAdvantage (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) (run : CliRun) (X : UnreachedPqxdhPrimitives) (W : PEParams) (l qep : Nat) {Pt : Type} (decT : PublicKey → Option Pt) (encT : Pt → PublicKey) (A : CliGameAdversary S l (BitVec 512)) : ℝ≥0∞ := 𝒟[cliPqExp S run X W l qep decT encT A].boolBias
end CryptoVerification.E2E
